g.text: Days before or after the nearest local full moon
1,026 reef-nights · Teal bars run from full moon through seven days later

text.style: font-size: 32.00px; font-weight: bold;fill: #183139; font-family: "Times New Roman";

g.text: Most spawning was recorded just after full moon
One record per reef subsite and local date. Source: Baird et al. (2021), Coral Spawning Database.
Survey effort varies. These shares describe recorded events and cannot predict spawning on an unobserved night.
